s.note: Soft pretzel bites with flaky salt and a sweet honey mustard dip
s.how: Heat the oven to 220C and line a tray with baking paper. Roll the dough into 4 long ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Bring the water and bicarb to the boil and boil the bites for 30 seconds in batches, then drain. Lay on the tray, brush with egg and sprinkle with the salt. Bake until deep brown. Mix the mustard, honey and mayonnaise and serve with the warm bites.

s.note: Hard-boiled eggs filled with a creamy yolk, mustard and mayonnaise mix, with smoked paprika and chives
s.how: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes. Cool in iced water. Peel, halve lengthways and scoop the yolks into a bowl. Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and salt until smooth and pipe back into the whites. Dust with the paprika and scatter with chives.

m.note: Pork and beef meatballs simmered in a basil tomato sauce over spaghetti with parmesan
m.how: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the beef and pork mince, egg, parmesan for the meatballs, the crushed garlic and half the salt. Roll into 20 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil in a wide pan and lift out. Soften the onion and sauce garlic in the pan, add the passata, the basil stalks and the rest of the salt, return the meatballs and simmer. Meanwhile cook 400g spaghetti in well salted boiling water until al dente and drain. Toss the spaghetti with a little sauce, top with the meatballs, torn basil leaves and the parmesan for serving.

w.note: Crisp biscuit base, tangy lime and condensed milk filling, whipped cream on top
w.how: Heat the oven to 170C. Mix the biscuit crumbs with the butter and press into a 23cm pie tin. Bake the base. Whisk the condensed milk, egg yolks, lime zest and 150ml lime juice until smooth. Pour into the base and bake until just set. Cool, then chill. Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread over the pie.

d.note: Golden rum with pineapple, orange and lime over ice, with a grenadine sunset
d.how: Stir the rum, pineapple juice, orange juice and lime juice in a jug. Chill. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses, drizzle in the grenadine so it sinks and add an orange slice.
